dedupe_keys.name: global industrial value added grids under global change scenarios 2010 2030 and 2050

description: This dataset gives gridded industrial value added in US dollars for the whole world in 2010, 2030 and 2050 under global change scenarios. The DataCite record says the GeoTIFF rasters (WGS 1984, global extent) were built from 2010 MODIS vegetation index and DMSP/OLS night-light data, the CMCC-CM climate model from CMIP5, World Bank World Development Indicators and national statistics, and GDP projections from a Chinese National Key R&D Program project on population and economic systems under global change. It was published on 6 August 2024 (version V1) by six authors as one file of about 12 MB (about 31.5 MB of data), free to download under CC BY 4.0; the metadata is in Chinese with English translation. Coverage is global. Caveats: the grid cell size and scenario definitions are not stated in the part of the record read, and future values are modelled. For simulation it gives a gridded industrial exposure layer, now and in future, to estimate the output at risk from floods, heat or storms. Related catalogue records include the global extreme precipitation exposure of industrial economies (same authors) and the industrial machinery stocks in 337 cities.
